title: Stream cleaned lines
hints: A file object is iterable line by line: `for line in lines:`. Never call readlines() on it.
line.split("#", 1)[0] or line.partition("#")[0] gives the text before the first #, whether or not one exists; then .strip().
Wrap the yield in `if text:` so blank results are skipped. Because the function contains yield, calling it returns a lazy generator automatically.
